name: Performance Grapher
description: Performance Grapher for CORSAIR XENEON Edge. Monitor iCUE sensor history with graph, bar, radial, or readout views, optional live FPS and frametime statistics, and an optional HTTPS response-time indicator. Customize sensor scales, sampling, warnings, typography, colors, header sizing, sensor readout sizing, and background transparency while keeping local history on this PC.
release_notes: 1.4.2 fixes a persistence regression where saved per-sensor Graph/Bar/Radial/Readout choices and custom LOW/HIGH scales could revert to Graph + Auto. Preferences now keep an additional sensor-set backup inside CORSAIR's documented localStorage[uniqueId] record, malformed/empty active records no longer suppress recovery, and existing valid 1.4.1 preferences migrate forward automatically while preserving the 1.4.1 transparency and readability fixes.
